findings.title: Fallback locales are not loaded when `I18n.t` is called outside `ApplicationController` or with a `:locale` option
findings.body: `I18n.fallbacks.ensure_loaded!` is only called in `ApplicationController#set_locale`, while `I18n.translate` in `lib/freedom_patches/translate_accelerator.rb` only calls `load_locale(config.locale)`. When `I18n::Backend::Fallbacks#translate` iterates over `I18n.fallbacks[locale]`, it calls `super(fallback, key, options)` directly on `I18n.backend`, bypassing `I18n.translate`. As a result, whenever `I18n.t` is called outside a controller action (e.g. in Sidekiq jobs, `UserNotifications` mailers, rake tasks, or specs), after `I18n.reload!`, or with an explicit `I18n.t(key, locale: ...)` / `I18n.with_locale(...)`, the fallback locales (or the passed `:locale`) are never loaded into `I18n.backend`. Fallback lookups then fail with missing translations, and for zero-argument `I18n.t(key)` calls, the missing-translation result gets cached in `@cache`. Ensuring fallback locales are loaded inside `load_locale`/`translate` in `translate_accelerator.rb` (including when `options[:locale]` is passed) avoids this.

findings.title: `FallbackLocaleList#[]` and `ensure_loaded!` do not normalize `locale` to a symbol
findings.body: In `FallbackLocaleList#[]`, `[locale, SiteSetting.default_locale.to_sym, :en].uniq.compact` leaves `locale` as-is while converting `SiteSetting.default_locale` and `:en` to symbols. When `I18n.t(key, locale: "en")` or `I18n.fallbacks["fr"]` is called with a string locale (such as `SiteSetting.default_locale` or `user.effective_locale`), `.uniq` does not deduplicate `"en"` and `:en` (returning `["en", :en]`), causing duplicate lookups on missing keys. Likewise, `I18n.ensure_loaded!` and `I18n.load_locale` in `lib/freedom_patches/translate_accelerator.rb` do not convert `locale` with `.to_sym`, so passing a string locale when the symbol locale is already in `@loaded_locales` will reload all YAML files for that locale a second time.

findings.title: No tests for server-side localization fallbacks
findings.body: This PR introduces `FallbackLocaleList` and enables server-side locale fallbacks across all environments, but adds no specs verifying the `[user_locale, SiteSetting.default_locale, :en]` fallback chain or that unloaded fallback locales are loaded on demand.
